enemies.name: Undertide Gloompincer
enemies.flavour_text: A Gloompincer that escaped from the arenas and adapted to life in the city's sewers. It has grown used to the darkness and has increased Movement Speed under the cover of night.

abilities.text: When in areas with no visibility, Movement Speed increases

enemies.name: Undertide Gloompincer α
enemies.flavour_text: A Gloompincer that escaped from the arenas and adapted to life in the city's sewers. It has grown used to the darkness and become much more savage. It has increased Movement Speed under the cover of night.

abilities.text: When in areas with no visibility, Movement Speed increases

enemies.name: Armorless Union Crossbowman
enemies.flavour_text: A crossbowman hired by the Armorless Union, lurking in the city's shadows. They are adept at hiding in the darkness and assassinating their targets with special bolts.

abilities.text: When in areas with no visibility, attacks deal Arts damage

enemies.name: Armorless Union Crossbowman Leader
enemies.flavour_text: A crossbowman leader hired by the Armorless Union, lurking in the city's shadows and posing a greater threat. They are adept at hiding in the darkness and assassinating their targets with special bolts.

abilities.text: When in areas with no visibility, attacks deal Arts damage

enemies.name: Armorless Union Assassin
enemies.flavour_text: An assassin hired by the Armorless Union, making up for their average skills with clever plots. They are adept at hiding in the darkness, sharpening their blades and continually increasing their ATK.

abilities.text: When in areas with no visibility, ATK continuously increases, and resets after the next attack

enemies.name: Armorless Union Assassin Leader
enemies.flavour_text: An assassin hired by the Armorless Union, complementing their remarkable skills with clever plots. They are adept at hiding in the darkness, sharpening their blades and continually increasing their ATK.

abilities.text: When in areas with no visibility, ATK continuously increases, and resets after the next attack

enemies.name: Knight Territory Wanderer
enemies.flavour_text: A commonly seen burly knight whose Knightclub affiliation is unknown, considered rogue. They're often found passed out drunk in dark alleyways, and demonstrate violent tendencies when woken up.

abilities.text: Remains Standby for a certain period in areas with <no visibility> and does not attack
If visibility is gained on its location, immediately becomes active

enemies.name: Knight Territory Hibernator
enemies.flavour_text: A commonly seen burly knight whose Knightclub affiliation is unknown, considered rogue. They're often found passed out drunk in dark alleyways, and should be avoided as they demonstrate ferociously violent tendencies when woken up.

abilities.text: Remains Standby for a certain period in areas with <no visibility> and does not attack
If visibility is gained on its location, immediately becomes active

enemies.name: Armorless Union Third Squad
enemies.flavour_text: A member of the squad led by Monique. As a member handpicked by the Lazurite based on her preferences, they have a much higher wage. Their attacks inflict Corrosion.

abilities.text: Every attack deals Corrosion
After several attacks, the next attack deals more damage

enemies.name: Armorless Union Third Squad Leader
enemies.flavour_text: A leader of the squad led by Monique and will take charge when Monique is absent. As a member handpicked by the Lazurite based on her preferences, they have an insanely high wage. Their attacks inflict Corrosion.

abilities.text: Every attack deals Corrosion
After several attacks, the next attack deals more damage

enemies.name: Lazurite, Monique
enemies.flavour_text: A Lazurite of the Armorless Union, Monique. She has a habit of recording her own condition in great detail before operations. She hates Roy and anyone who interrupts her work.

abilities.text: Every attack deals Corrosion
After several attacks, the next attack deals more damage

enemies.name: Armorless Union Cleanup Squad
enemies.flavour_text: A member of the cleanup squad personally trained by Roy. Most of the time, Roy takes a hands-off attitude with the squad, so they have adopted some kind of bounty system and are often very thorough in their tasks. Their attacks inflict Corrosion.

abilities.text: Every attack deals Corrosion
After several attacks, the next attack deals more damage

enemies.name: Armorless Union Cleanup Squad Leader
enemies.flavour_text: A leader of the cleanup squad personally trained by Roy. They lead the squad in place of Roy, who refuses to work, and are very experienced. The squad has adopted some kind of bounty system and is often very thorough in their tasks. Their attacks inflict Corrosion.

abilities.text: Every attack deals Corrosion
After several attacks, the next attack deals more damage

enemies.name: Lazurite, Roy
enemies.flavour_text: A Lazurite of the Armorless Union, Roy. No one knows how a killer managed to achieve such a position and hold it for so many years. Rumor says that his wealth has already surpassed the CEOs of some small companies, while his power exceeds many competition knights.

abilities.text: Every attack deals Corrosion
After several attacks, the next attack deals more damage

enemies.name: Nova Knightclub Trainee
enemies.flavour_text: A trainee of the Nova Knightclub. With the Candle Knight as its figurehead, this Knightclub with a beautiful name recruits elegant knights proficient in using Arts from far and wide. Though there is occasional displeasure over being forced to imitate the Candle Knight, the popularity and wealth it brings remain a big draw of the Knightclub.

abilities.text: [Glimmering Touch] After charging for some time, deals a large amount of Arts damage to a target and all surrounding units
While charging, loses Invisibility

enemies.name: Nova Knightclub Elite
enemies.flavour_text: An elite of the Nova Knightclub. With the Candle Knight as its figurehead, this Knightclub with a beautiful name recruits elegant knights proficient in using Arts from far and wide. Many of these elites have achieved great mastery over their Arts, some even plotting to overthrow the Candle Knight.

abilities.text: [Glimmering Touch] After charging for some time, deals a large amount of Arts damage to a target and all surrounding units
While charging, loses Invisibility

enemies.name: The Candle Knight Viviana
enemies.flavour_text: The Candle Knight, Viviana Droste. Words fail to describe her beauty, her brilliant eyes alone are enchanting enough. Tonight, the marigolds bloom for her.

abilities.text: [Glimmering Touch] After charging for some time, deals a large amount of Arts damage to a target and all surrounding units
While charging, loses Invisibility

enemies.name: Nightzmora Imitator
enemies.flavour_text: Pretenders who began following Nightmare Knight after his battles and 'Performance Art'. Though the form is true, the substance is lacking. Perhaps they can be considered a type of fan as well.

abilities.text: [Coalescing Fear] Deals Physical damage to all operators with no visibility directly behind them

enemies.name: Nightzmora Follower
enemies.flavour_text: Pretenders who began following Nightmare Knight after his battles and 'Performance Art'. Many attempt to guess at the true identity of the Nightzmora from ancient texts and history books, even though he himself considers it blasphemy against the ancient rituals.

abilities.text: [Coalescing Fear] Deals Physical damage to all operators with no visibility directly behind them

enemies.name: 'The Last Kheshig', Tola
enemies.flavour_text: The Nightzmora has never acknowledged his knightly title. The city and civilization itself are nothing but obstacles on his path of conquest. The meaning modern Kazimierz bestows upon the knights represents a total desecration of his history to which he is so devoted.

abilities.text: [Coalescing Fear] Deals Physical damage to all operators with no visibility directly behind them

enemies.name: Bloodblade
enemies.flavour_text: Blood that bows to the will of the Blood Knight, re-animating and coagulating into the shape of a sharp blade.

abilities.text: After coming into contact with the <Blood Knight>, disappears and restores a certain amount of the <Blood Knight's> HP

enemies.name: The Blood Knight Dikaiopolis
enemies.flavour_text: The Blood Knight, Dikaiopolis. The originator of Kazimierz's Infected Knight program, the hero of the Grand Knight Territory's Infected, and an idol to countless children. What exactly did the 'hero' give up to obtain the peace we know today?

abilities.text: Reduce damage taken, but damage reduction does not work on units blocking it
First Form
[Exsanguination] Stuns the target, dealing Arts damage every second
Resurrection Stance
Blood Knight is invulnerable and continuously summons <Bloodblades>; enters the Second Form after some time
[Resurrection Stance] If the Blood Knight's HP is restored to its maximum while in this stance, he will return to his first form
Second Form
Gains increased ATK and attacks become ranged
Continuously summons <Bloodblades>
